text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japan Cup is here. Narita Brian resolves to win the race and go speak with Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon is among today's opponents. It's their first G1 rematch since last year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She asks Narita Brian what her racing life will look like from now on…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian answers that she's going to keep running and continue to be a competitor. With both holding strong to their convictions, their one-on-one begins!
